_about.what: bionic's shipped permission profile TEMPLATE. Rendered at setup by scripts/lib/profile.sh, applied into the USER settings layer under explicit consent, diffed by doctor, stripped by remove.
_about.token: __BIONIC_PLUGIN_ROOT__ is replaced with this machine's concrete plugin root. Permission rules take literal paths and globs only — no variable expansion — so the token must never reach a settings file (record/epic-17-w3/probe-identity-match.md, design D2-final).
_about.markers: The first and last allow entries bracket the block bionic owns. They are exact-match rules for ':' — bash's no-op builtin — so they authorize nothing while remaining valid rule syntax the CLI can only ignore. Everything in permissions.allow outside them is the machine's own accretion.
_about.version_rule: version here, and the version carried by the begin marker, both equal payload/.claude-plugin/plugin.json's version. One manifest is the truth (ADR-002); tests/version-ssot.test.sh and tests/profile.test.sh pin all three together.
_about.derivation: Every rule below has a named invoker. hooks/* mirrors the six scripts named in hooks/hooks.json's commands. scripts/* is the command surface's four payload scripts. tests/run.sh is the suite CLAUDE.md makes every agent run, in both the plain and farm-out-allowed spellings. The claude plugin rules are scoped to bionic's own plugin@marketplace pair. Nothing here grants a whole tool, a bare wildcard, or a permission-skipping flag; a rule with no invoker behind it is an unearned grant.
